title: Installing upgraded stormwater infrastructure
description:
City of San Diego crews are hard at work in Rolando Village installing upgraded stormwater infrastructure to protect homes and streets ahead of a strong predicted El Niño rainy season. 

Infrastructure improvements happen year-round thanks to the Stormwater Department’s dedicated in-house engineering, repair and maintenance teams. This work is crucial to making San Diego neighborhoods more flood-resilient. 

Residents can also prepare ahead of the rainy season. For tips on preparing your home, visit the City’s storm preparedness page: sandiego.gov/storm-preparedness.
